question: What totality is claimed in relation to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: Reference is made to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
A totality of all fields is attributed to them.
inference: The full group of fields belonging to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs is intended.
uncertainties: The structure of that field-group is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: The whole group of fields of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
